source.gate0_candidate_rule: at least 5 distinct nest-count years spanning at least 10 years over the full pinned record

per_unit_window_criteria.bridge_definition: at least one observation year in the first third and at least one in the last third of the candidate window

primary_window_selection_rule.rule: Choose the longest candidate window for which each of ADPE, CHPE and GEPE retains at least 50% of its Gate0 candidate units under the bridged criterion. If no candidate window qualifies, do not open a common-window trend endpoint.

summaries_required: overall and species-specific counts meeting basic and bridged criteria
APBP region counts among bridged units
median distinct observation years and median observed span by species/window
boundary: Count magnitudes are not summarized or modeled.
Only the existence/year of non-missing nest-count records is used.
Observation method/accuracy is audited separately and does not affect window selection.
No island/breeding-option trait association is fit.
